headline: 5 Sui on-chain identifiers catalogued (1 package, 1 LST state object, 1 weight hook, 1 LST coin type, 1 ecosystem LST token) from docs and GitHub; DeFiPunkd read-API and EVM block explorers not applicable to Sui chain.

findings.text: D1: Sui uses SuiScan/Suivision explorers rather than EVM explorers; DeFiPunkd's read API supports only EVM chainIds (1, 10, 56, 130, 137, 324, 8453, 42161, 43114, 59144, 81457, 534352, 11155111) — Sui is not listed. No EVM block-explorer name-tag search applicable. Recorded in unknowns.

D2: Canonical deployed-addresses page found at docs.suilend.fi/springsui/springsui-integration. Three key on-chain identifiers extracted: LiquidStakingInfo object ID (0x15eda…), package address (0x8355…::spring_sui::SPRING_SUI), and weightHookId (0xbbaf…). No single flat 'deployments' table found; addresses are embedded in SDK code examples.

D3: Audit index at docs.suilend.fi/security/suilend-audit lists three audits: Zellic (March 5, 2024), OtterSec (March 20, 2024), Certora formal verification (February 2026). Audit PDFs are on Google Drive — not directly fetchable by this tool. Scope/addresses in audit PDFs not extractable this run; recorded in unknowns.

D4: GitHub repo https://github.com/suilend/liquid-staking confirmed public (MIT license, 137 commits, main branch). README is minimal (3 lines). No broadcast/hardhat-deploy artifacts visible in repo root listing; a 'contracts' subdirectory and 'audits' subdirectory exist. Second repo https://github.com/solendprotocol/springsui (TS monorepo with frontend, SDK, CLI) referenced in docs but URL returned error — recorded in unknowns. No pinned commit SHA extractable from fetched page (GitHub rendered dynamic metadata, not raw commit SHA in body).

D5: SpringSui operates on Sui only (single chain per protocol.chains). No multi-chain enumeration required. One ecosystem LST (xSUI by Momentum Finance, contract 0x2b6602…::x_sui::X_SUI) surfaced from search results as a SpringSui-standard-built LST — recorded as 'other' role.

D6: SpringSui acts as a factory/standard for third-party LSTs. One child LST (xSUI at 0x2b6602099970374cf58a2a1b9d96f005fccceb81e92eb059873baf420eb6c717) surfaced from search. Full enumeration of factory children not possible without Sui-compatible read API. Recorded in unknowns with D6 cap notice.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: package address classified as 'other' (Move package/module), LiquidStakingInfo as 'vault' (holds StakedSui objects and controls LST issuance), weightHookId as 'other' (validator weight distribution hook), sSUI coin type as 'token'. All actor_class set to 'unknown' pending Sui on-chain read.

D8: All admin_addresses entries trace to fetched URL docs.suilend.fi/springsui/springsui-integration. xSUI ecosystem LST address traces to search result from mmtfinance.medium.com. No snippet-only sightings without a fetched URL.

rationale.verdict: Walked springsui.com (minimal SPA content), docs.suilend.fi (integration page, intro page, audit index), and github.com/suilend/liquid-staking (repo root and README). Extracted 3 core protocol object identifiers and 1 package address from official docs code examples. Audits confirmed (3 firms). On-chain reads via DeFiPunkd API not possible (Sui not supported). Total: 5 Sui on-chain identifiers catalogued.

protocol_metadata.about: SpringSui is a liquid staking protocol on Sui, built by the Suilend team, that allows users to stake SUI and receive sSUI (Spring Staked SUI), a liquid staking token (LST) whose yield accrues via price appreciation rather than rebasing. The core innovation is instant unstaking enabled by Sui Improvement Proposal SIP-33, which allows redemption of sSUI for SUI in a single transaction without waiting for epoch boundaries, eliminating depegging risk. SpringSui also functions as an open, permissionless framework (the 'SpringSui Standard') enabling third-party teams to deploy their own LSTs on the platform at no cost. The protocol has been audited by Zellic and OtterSec (March 2024) and Certora via formal verification (February 2026).
